panels.description: One row per Claude Code session, drawn as one solid bar in the session's own colour from its first prompt's start to its last prompt's end. A session that started before the range and was used again in it runs from the start of the range. Idle time between prompts is included, even if the session was closed and resumed. Hover a bar for the session's prompt count and tokens (input, output, cache read and cache write together) in the range, its Session Age, from its first prompt's start to its last prompt's end, and its Activity Time, the time its prompts ran for, idle time left out. Session Age and Activity Time include the session's prompts from before the range. Grafana's own Duration in the tooltip is only the part of the bar inside the range. Shows the 30 most recently active sessions in the range. Colours are assigned in the order sessions started, so they can change with the time range or filters. Rows are labelled with the session's repository (GH:, GL: or BB: and its path, or Unknown) and the first 8 characters of its session ID. Times are shown in your browser's timezone.

targets.rawSql:
-- base is every prompt the panel may show, s spans and ranks each session, whole measures each
-- session from its first prompt, and shown keeps the 30 most recently active sessions and numbers
-- them for their colours. The outer query turns each
-- session into a start point and an end point, so it draws as one solid bar. A session is shown
-- when a prompt of it overlaps the range, and its bar starts at the session's first prompt, even
-- one before the range, so a session resumed in the range runs from the range's start.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.workspace_key, p.session_id, p.started_at, p.ended_at, p.repository_url,
    p.input_tokens + p.output_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens AS tokens
  FROM ai_prompts p
  -- Prompts that overlap the time range, so a prompt that began before the range still shows.
  WHERE p.started_at < $__timeTo() AND p.ended_at > $__timeFrom()
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    -- user is single-select, so this is one user.
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) = ${user:sqlstring}
    -- '__all__' is the Repository filter's allValue: All sends it instead of the option list, so a
    -- range with no repositories can't produce IN ().
    AND ('__all__' IN (${repository:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
), s AS (
  SELECT workspace_key, session_id,
    MAX(repository_url) AS repository_url,
    MAX(ended_at) AS last_end,
    -- Shown in the bar's tooltip. Tokens are input, output, cache read and cache write together.
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    SUM(tokens) AS tokens,
    -- 1 is the session that was active most recently.
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(ended_at) DESC, workspace_key, session_id) AS recency
  FROM base
  GROUP BY workspace_key, session_id
), whole AS (
  -- Each session's prompts up to the range's end, including those before the range, which base
  -- leaves out: the session's first prompt, and the time its prompts ran for.
  SELECT e.workspace_key, e.session_id, MIN(e.started_at) AS first_start,
    ROUND(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, e.started_at, e.ended_at)) / 1000000) AS activity_seconds
  FROM ai_prompts e
  JOIN s ON s.workspace_key = e.workspace_key AND s.session_id = e.session_id
  WHERE e.started_at < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY e.workspace_key, e.session_id
), shown AS (
  -- colour numbers the shown sessions 1, 2, 3… in the order they started; each number maps to
  -- its own colour in the panel's value mappings.
  SELECT s.*, w.first_start, w.activity_seconds,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY w.first_start, s.workspace_key, s.session_id) AS colour,
    -- A session that began before the range starts its bar at the range's start.
    GREATEST(w.first_start, $__timeFrom()) AS bar_start,
    -- Session Age runs from the session's first prompt's start to its last prompt's end.
    ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, w.first_start, s.last_end) / 1000000) AS age_seconds,
    -- The repository is labelled as on the Claude Prompts dashboards: GH:, GL: or BB: and the path,
    -- or the host for other servers.
    CONCAT(CASE
        WHEN s.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
        -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
        WHEN s.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
        ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(s.repository_url, '^https?://', '')
      END, ' · ', LEFT(s.session_id, 8)) AS session_label
  FROM s
  JOIN whole w ON w.workspace_key = s.workspace_key AND w.session_id = s.session_id
  -- More rows than this can't be read in one panel, and the panel maps 30 colours. Narrow the
  -- User or Repository filter instead.
  WHERE s.recency <= 30
)
SELECT t AS time, session_label AS session, state
FROM (
  -- The session's bar runs from its first prompt's start, or the range's start if that is earlier, to
  -- its last prompt's end, idle time included.
  -- state is "<colour number>|<tooltip text>": the panel's regex mappings colour the bar by the number
  -- and show the text, the session's prompt count, tokens, Session Age and Activity Time, in the tooltip.
  SELECT bar_start AS t, 0 AS kind, session_label,
    CONCAT(colour, '|', prompts, IF(prompts = 1, ' prompt', ' prompts'), ' · ',
      CASE
        WHEN tokens >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(tokens / 1000000000, 1), 'B')
        WHEN tokens >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(tokens / 1000000, 1), 'M')
        WHEN tokens >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(tokens / 1000, 1), 'K')
        ELSE tokens
      END, ' tokens · Session Age ', CASE
        WHEN age_seconds >= 86400 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(age_seconds / 86400), 'd ', FLOOR(MOD(age_seconds, 86400) / 3600), 'h')
        WHEN age_seconds >= 3600 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(age_seconds / 3600), 'h ', FLOOR(MOD(age_seconds, 3600) / 60), 'm')
        WHEN age_seconds >= 60 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(age_seconds / 60), 'm ', MOD(age_seconds, 60), 's')
        ELSE CONCAT(age_seconds, 's')
      END,
      ' · Activity Time ', CASE
        WHEN activity_seconds >= 86400 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(activity_seconds / 86400), 'd ', FLOOR(MOD(activity_seconds, 86400) / 3600), 'h')
        WHEN activity_seconds >= 3600 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(activity_seconds / 3600), 'h ', FLOOR(MOD(activity_seconds, 3600) / 60), 'm')
        WHEN activity_seconds >= 60 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(activity_seconds / 60), 'm ', MOD(activity_seconds, 60), 's')
        ELSE CONCAT(activity_seconds, 's')
      END) AS state
  FROM shown
  UNION ALL
  -- After the last prompt the state is NULL, so the row shows nothing until the range ends.
  SELECT last_end, 1, session_label, NULL
  FROM shown
) pts
ORDER BY t, kind

list.definition:
-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
-- The viewer's own email sorts first, so the dashboard opens on their sessions.
ORDER BY u.user = ${__user.email:sqlstring} DESC, 1;

list.definition:
-- Repositories the selected user's prompts ran in during the time range, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- A prompt counts when it overlaps the range, as on the Session Timeline panel, so a prompt that began
-- before the range still lists its repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.status = 'active' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND p.started_at < $__timeTo() AND p.ended_at > $__timeFrom()
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
